name: poll
description: Put a question to the class and show the answers on the projector. Type /poll followed by the question and it goes up immediately — Claude reads the sentence, works out the question type and the right answer, and the app runs it: multiple choice, word clouds, confidence scales, numeric estimates, and rankings, all updating live as students answer. /poll with a filename runs a poll written before class instead. Anonymous by design, so concept checks get honest answers.
